QuestInfo.name: Saffron's Herb Oil
QuestInfo.0: Learn how to make Herb Oil.
QuestInfo.1: Go back to Saffron's Herb Garden and gather #b#t4022022##k. \nOpen the Profession window (hotkey B) and make #b#t4023022##k.
QuestInfo.2: Saffron prepared a bag for you to gather herbs in.

0.0: All right, let's extract some oil! Are you ready?

yes.0: Go back to my Herb Field and gather #b#t4022022##k. Come back after you open the Profession window (hotkey B) and make #b#t4023022##k.
yes.1: You can purchase #b#t4024000##k from #b#p9031007##k to hold the oil.

no.0: L-let me know when you're ready!

1.0: Oh, I hope it wasn't too hard...

yes.0: You can use oils in Smithing, Accessory Crafting, and Alchemy. The bag I gave you is just for holding herbs and oil. Please make good use of it!
yes.1: Y-you're off to a good start! The best thing to do now is start harvesting herbs in the Harvesting Farm.

item.0: Go back to my Herb Field and gather #b#t4022022##k. Come back after you open the Profession window (hotkey B) and make #b#t4023022##k.
